with this surgery and the NHS has never been at its worse. I recently desperately needed an inhaler because I was gasping for breath with a chest problem, I'd had an inhaler prescribed about 2 years ago but only needed one short term. Could I get one now? No? You'll have to get a phone call from the doctor. But I'm desperate, how long will it take? About a week. It was getting worse and worse but at the end of the week I rang again and was told the doctor wouild ring me on Monday, I waited all day but no call. Another long weekend and now this! Come Tuesday all I got was a phone call from the local pharmicist who I've never met, he was offering 'advice' but couldn't prescribe an inhaler. I could hardly walk to the A&E who I had to turn to in the end. It took 4 hours faffing around, taking my blood pressure... more faffing around and waiting. Eventually, finally, having been seen by nurses or physician assistants (or whatever they are called but they're not doctors) I was seen by a young doctor and he agreed. 'Oh, erm yes, I think you need an inhaler.' It's actually very frightening when you can't breathe but I didn't want to overburden the A&E department. All GPs seem to do nowadays is pass you on: to the end of a phone call, to a nurse, to the pharmacy, to A&E, anything but actually see, talk to and treat their patients. And they want a pay rise! (yet don't know anything about the hippocratic oath: first do no harm, which is what they are doing). Before this surgery was set up, it was a single doctor who ran the practice from his house - very popular, very reliable.You might have to wait, but you could walk in any day and would be seen. For urgent cases, he even saw patients on Saturday mornings (and made home visits!). The only reason he retired early was because the NHS started to say he needed to build disabled access and a lift, though they weren't interested in paying for it (there was another doctor nearby who could have taken patients who couldn't manage the staircase btw). He closed and his patients had to be seen by another doctor in a portacabin. Eventually the Rosendale surgery was opened (costing thousands); yet that was a poor investment as they moved again, to the Old Dairy. There are a few good reviews on here (also one or two who are apparently doctors or medical people themselves - but is a fellow GP really going to give a negative review on a colleague?) but most are justifiably poor. The good ones where you give 5 stars because the staff were polite and/or helpful are silly, being polite and helpful is a normal part of being professional and doesn't warrant 5 stars or calling something outstanding. In most cases those giving 5 stars have only seen the doctor once or twice and are new to the surgery, reviews from patients who have been with the surgery more long term are far more valuable.",null,[0,237]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2kxdWFXNTNaRm90TUU5amFVYzJXbXhFZUVsNE5sRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xf18f36994fc4a90d!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOi1uaW53ZFotME9jaUc2WmxEeEl4NlE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2kxdWFXNTNaRm90TUU5amFVYzJXbXhFZUVsNE5sRRAB&t=1&-ZNo_xKgswZEVqNUtPY2ZPZw&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjb7pahi7STAxXiMGMBHcUDDvoQoykIDSgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjb7pahi7STAxXiMGMBHcUDDvoQ0pMFCAsoAw"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCQnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMVJwU1VaQ1NsOWZSV2hDVGxSU2J6bFJkMHBFUlc1TWFFeFhUVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSZDBOYVQwbG5WVVZyV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT201V1FTMVlZWEp2ZEhOQlRrSndNVFIyUkRCTFRYYxAB",["0x0:0xf18f36994fc4a90d",null,1752575078209229,1763632905995158,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/111496830706167704572/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["W S","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJfVBWHOcr-FSS6yHBhMStVbPludDoLSsWENKbr1BwXx4TT7g=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/111496830706167704572?hl=en"],"111496830706167704572",null,10,0,null,[0,3,1],0,["10 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjb7pahi7STAxXiMGMBHcUDDvoQ7LoGCA8oAA"]]]],null,"Edited 4 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["The young lady with the piercings was great.

Prompt and friendly replies and staff that actually care about you and take time to listen. I’ve called about two issues that other GPs in the past have not taken seriously and was promptly referred to specialists.
